summary: Crescent Biopharma filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing clinical pipeline updates rather than a transactional event. The press release details enrollment progress in the global Phase 1/2 ASCEND trial of CR-001, a PD-1 x VEGF bispecific, plus plans for ADC combination studies, the anticipated Phase 1/2 APOLLO trial of CR-002 (a PD-L1-targeting topoisomerase inhibitor ADC), and data-readout timing. Initial ASCEND monotherapy data is expected in Q1 2027, chemotherapy combination data in mid-2027, and the first Phase 3 trial in early 2028. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are stated.
